subject.title: refactor(sessions): move inbound meta, goals, and delivery reads behind the session accessor

question: Should this focused accessor-adoption slice land independently after rebase validation, or be folded into the broader session/transcript storage-flip lane?
rationale: The code follows the accessor-boundary direction, but the maintainer label, canonical migration tracker, SDK facade touch, and behind-base store.ts change make sequencing a human ownership decision.

options.title: Land Focused Slice
options.body: Rebase onto current main, rerun the focused accessor, delivery-info, goals, compaction, SDK API, and boundary-guard checks, then review this PR as an independent seam migration.

options.title: Fold Into Storage Flip
options.body: Move the unique accessor migrations into the broader SQLite flip branch and supersede this PR only after the replacement branch contains equivalent proof.

options.title: Pause For Tracker Direction
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer merge work until maintainers confirm the active implementation lane for the canonical migration tracker.

recommendation.title: Land Focused Slice
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, rerun the focused accessor, delivery-info, goals, compaction, SDK API, and boundary-guard checks, then review this PR as an independent seam migration.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman owns the tracker text and the recent sequence of accessor-seam PRs that this slice belongs to.
